messages.text: BL-2075 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfix 9835684bbf: the iq3 hardender/cleaner cards now forbid bare Stryker and name the scoped shape (stryker.blXXXX + vitest.blXXXX.stryker, concurrency 8+), the cleaner runs mutation-site-count before forward, the architect never runs the property lane or Stryker, and QA runs qa-gather instead of listing checks by hand - so a local-model TypeScript parcel can no longer burn hundreds of hours on a default-config Stryker run
